column1: Method 1: Run via Newman CLI (Recommended / Fastest)
column2:
1. Ensure Node.js (v18+) is installed on your machine.
2. Open your terminal in the extracted folder ("d:\Test Astro").
3. Run: npm test
   (Or run: node runner.js)
4. Newman will execute all 11 test cases and print live colored test results and statistics.
5. An interactive HTML report will be generated at "./reports/reqres-api-report.html".

column1: Method 2: Run via Postman Desktop GUI
column2:
1. Open the Postman Desktop Application.
2. In the top-left corner, click "Import".
3. Drag and drop both JSON files from the "./postman/" directory:
   - astronauts-reqres-collection.json
   - astronauts-reqres-environment.json
4. In the top-right environment selector, select "ReqRes - Astronauts QA Environment".
5. Click on the collection "Astronauts QA Assessment - ReqRes API Automation" and click "Run Collection".
6. Click "Run Astronauts QA Assessment" to see real-time graphical assertion passes.
